title: Three unidentified objects shot down in the Chinese balloon week

tellings.quote: The week of the Chinese balloon, there were three other unidentified objects that the military said they shot down.

plain: In 2023, during the week a Chinese balloon crossed North American airspace, the military said it shot down three other unidentified objects. Pippa Malmgren, the daughter of the presidential adviser Harald Malmgren, mentions this without naming a source. She raises it to suggest that unknown objects are being met in the skies today, not only in the past.
